title: Recover fresh legacy cmux registry locks before timeout
description: New Nexus still times out when an empty metadata-less cmux registry lock directory was recently created by an older or interrupted process. Lower the legacy metadata-less stale threshold so the app self-heals before the 5s acquisition timeout.
design: Keep metadata-owned locks authoritative; use a shorter legacy-lock stale threshold for metadata-less directories because current lock holders write owner metadata immediately after mkdir.
acceptance_criteria: A metadata-less cmux registry lock older than the acquisition timeout is removed before throwing, active metadata-owned locks remain serialized, and e2e coverage proves recovery.
close_reason: Lowered metadata-less cmux registry legacy lock stale threshold and added failing-then-passing e2e coverage for recovery before timeout.

title: Self-heal stale cmux session registry locks
description: Nexus can leave cmux session registry lock directories behind after process interruption, causing extension startup to time out. Implement app-level stale lock recovery and deterministic e2e coverage.
design: Use lock-directory metadata with pid/createdAt, stale-age detection, safe takeover retries, and backwards-compatible cleanup of metadata-less stale directories.
acceptance_criteria: Nexus removes stale cmux session registry lock directories safely, still serializes active writers, and e2e coverage proves recovery.
close_reason: Implemented cmux registry stale lock self-healing with metadata ownership and e2e regression coverage.
